one_line: OpenAI tightens safety, governments act on AI security, and new models and funding reshape the sector.

themes.title: OpenAI resumes training offline
themes.text: OpenAI restarted training its frontier models in an offline environment after adding monitoring checks and fixing a Brotli compression flaw, and its Project Daybreak program helped discover critical PHP remote‑code‑execution bugs.

stories.headline: OpenAI trains frontier AI models without internet access
OpenAI resumes training of frontier AI models after security overhaul
OpenAI’s Project Daybreak helps uncover critical PHP RCE bugs

themes.title: Governments fund AI biosecurity
themes.text: The UK will spend £100 million to create a national AI Biosecurity Lab with support from OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepMind, while the U.S. Treasury proposes broader investment curbs on Chinese AI and biotech firms, and India’s SEBI plans an AI sandbox and broker compliance framework.

stories.headline: UK to invest £100 million in AI Biosecurity Lab
US Treasury proposes expanding investment curbs on Chinese AI and biotech firms
SEBI to introduce graded broker compliance, AI sandbox, and corporate bond reforms

themes.title: AI firms report mixed funding
themes.text: Pathos AI secured $237 million Series E at a $3 billion valuation, whereas Infosys saw AI revenue rise 29% QoQ but lowered its FY27 growth outlook to 1‑2%.

stories.headline: Pathos AI raises $237 million Series E led by Bristol Myers Squibb
Infosys AI revenue rises 29% QoQ as FY27 growth guidance cut to 1-2%

themes.title: New AI models hit market
themes.text: Moonshot launched the Kimi K3.1 Pro with open‑weight access and competitive pricing, and Block introduced Dessa, a full‑duplex speech‑to‑speech model that runs locally on consumer GPUs.

stories.headline: Moonshot launches Kimi K3.1 Pro with open‑weight promise and competitive pricing
Block releases Dessa, a full‑duplex speech‑to‑speech model that runs locally
